5.7
Workspace Management Module
The workspace module allows users to organize multiple research projects.
Each workspace contains:
• Uploaded documents
• Vector database
• Research history
• Metadata
Workspace isolation ensures that documents belonging to different research projects
remain independent.
5.8
Frontend Implementation
The user interface is developed using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Jinja2 templates.
The application provides the following pages:
• Login Page
• Registration Page
• Dashboard
• Chat Interface
• Document Management Page
The frontend communicates with the FastAPI backend through REST APIs.
5.9
REST API Design
FastAPI automatically generates REST APIs for every module.
The project exposes APIs for:
• User Authentication
• Workspace Management
• Document Upload
• Chat
